text: [Chemical, acquisition] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: how export controls and scheduled-chemical declarations work, why particular chemicals are controlled, industrial and agricultural supply and regulatory history of the Chemical Weapons Convention. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: identifying suppliers or channels for controlled precursors, substitutions reaching the same agent from uncontrolled inputs, extracting a controlled chemical from a commercial product, quantities or ordering patterns that avoid reporting thresholds and cover stories or end-use claims for a purchase. For the purposes of this provision, explaining that a control regime exists is education; helping someone move through or around it is acquisition assistance.

[Chemical, production] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: mechanisms of toxicity and dose-response, exposure limits, symptoms, clinical management and antidotes, general reaction chemistry and why an agent is or is not persistent. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: synthesis routes, reaction conditions, stoichiometry or yields for an agent or its immediate precursors, purification, drying or stabilisation raising purity or shelf life, scale-up from laboratory to usable quantity, equipment selection or improvisation for such a process and troubleshooting a described attempt. For the purposes of this provision, a stated academic, defensive, historical or fictional purpose does not change what the text would enable; assess the capability transferred, not the reason attached.

[Chemical, deployment] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: detection instrumentation and how it works, protective equipment, decontamination procedure, spill and incident response and the history of chemical warfare and its victims. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: formulation for dispersal, thickening or particle sizing, munition, sprayer or improvised dispersal-device design, release planning against enclosed spaces, ventilation, water supplies or crowds, timing, siting or conditions chosen to raise exposure and defeating detectors, protective equipment or decontamination. For the purposes of this provision, describing how protection works so it can be used is the protective side of the same knowledge; selecting or optimising a release is not.

[Biological, acquisition] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: how select-agent registration and gene-synthesis screening work, where published analysis says screening has gaps, biosafety levels and culture collection governance. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: isolating a controlled pathogen or toxin from environmental or clinical sources, suppliers or intermediaries likely to ship without scrutiny, framing an order or affiliation to avoid registration or sequence screening, splitting or disguising a sequence order to defeat screening and transporting or storing such material undetected. For the purposes of this provision, the screening architecture is a legitimate subject of public policy analysis; routes through it are not.

[Biological, production] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: pathogen biology and genetics, transmission dynamics and epidemiology, clinical presentation and case management, diagnostics, vaccines, therapeutics and standard laboratory technique as taught. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: culture or fermentation protocols aimed at weapon-relevant quantity, increasing transmissibility, virulence, host range or environmental persistence, resistance to available vaccines or therapeutics, reconstruction of a controlled agent from sequence and toxin extraction, concentration or purification. For the purposes of this provision, the prohibition tracks the intended enhancement, not the technique in the abstract; the same methods are in textbooks and in daily legitimate use.

[Biological, deployment] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: outbreak modelling for preparedness, surveillance systems, sterilisation and containment practice, outbreak history and public health response planning. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: stabilisation, drying, milling or encapsulation to survive dispersal, particle sizing chosen for respiratory deposition, aerosol generation or sprayer design, contamination of food, water or ventilation systems, targets, timing or conditions chosen to maximise infection or spread and evading environmental detection or medical countermeasures. For the purposes of this provision, modelling how an outbreak spreads is epidemiology when the purpose is understanding or preparedness, and not when it is choosing a release.

[Radiological and Nuclear (WMD), acquisition] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: how safeguards, source registries and detection architectures work, non-proliferation policy and its published critiques, medical and industrial isotope supply and licensing and transport regulation. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: identifying facilities, transports or disused sources as theft targets, defeating physical protection, material accounting or portal monitors, smuggling routes or methods, sourcing through illicit markets or intermediaries and enrichment or reprocessing as a route to fissile material. For the purposes of this provision, safeguards scholarship describes the architecture; target selection applies it.

[Radiological and Nuclear (WMD), production] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: reactor physics and fuel cycles, radioactive decay and dosimetry, radiation biology, the history of weapons programmes and of accidents and arms-control policy. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: weapon design parameters, critical masses or geometries, implosion or gun-assembly arrangements, initiators, tampers, reflectors, enrichment or reprocessing process detail sufficient to guide an attempt, machining, metallurgy or handling of weapons-usable material and breaching or aerosolising a sealed source. For the purposes of this provision, that a fragment appeared in a declassified document does not make assembling it into usable guidance appropriate; the question is what the response enables.

[Radiological and Nuclear (WMD), deployment] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: emergency planning, sheltering and evacuation guidance, survey and remediation of contaminated areas, detection instrumentation and medical management of radiation exposure. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: target selection and reconnaissance, placement, height or timing chosen to maximise casualties or contamination, dispersion conditions selected for the same purpose, shielding a source to avoid portal monitors or aerial survey and defeating radiation detection or decontamination. For the purposes of this provision, preparedness material protects people; the same facts arranged to choose a target do not.

[Explosives, acquisition] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: licensing, storage and record-keeping regulation, how precursor reporting schemes work and how effective evaluations find them and commercial blasting supply chains. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: identifying retail or industrial products as precursor sources, extraction or concentration of a precursor from a consumer product, purchasing patterns or framing to stay below reporting thresholds, sourcing detonators or commercial explosives outside licensed channels and theft from magazines, worksites or transports. For the purposes of this provision, the reporting regime is a legitimate policy subject; staying below it is acquisition assistance.

[Explosives, production] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: chemistry of oxidisers and fuels, thermodynamics and detonation physics, blast propagation and structural response, commercial demolition and mining practice and blast-injury medicine. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: formulations, ratios or quantities for an improvised explosive or its precursors, synthesis, sensitisation or stabilisation procedures, charge design, confinement or casing, fragmentation or shaped-charge arrangements, initiation, detonator or triggering-circuit design including timers, remote and victim-operated switches and troubleshooting a described build. For the purposes of this provision, the step from published chemistry to a working device is exactly the step assistance would supply.

[Explosives, deployment] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: how screening and trace detection work, blast-resistant building design, protective security for crowded places, how investigators reconstruct an attack and unexploded-ordnance clearance. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: target selection and reconnaissance, placement, charge siting or timing to maximise casualties or collapse, exploiting crowd movement, evacuation routes or responders, incl. secondary devices, concealment from search, screening or trace detection and defeating render-safe procedures. For the purposes of this provision, protective security is the mirror image of this and should be answered.

[Terrorism, operational] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: motivations, ideologies and organisational history, radicalisation and disengagement research, counter-terrorism law and its civil-liberties debates, financing typologies as studied by regulators, effects on victims and communities, and how they recover and how a reported attack was carried out, after the fact. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: planning, target selection or reconnaissance, surveillance and counter-surveillance technique, acquiring restricted materials or weapons, moving or concealing funds, or structuring transactions to defeat monitoring, secure coordination intended to defeat lawful investigation and recruitment or radicalisation material aimed at an audience. For the purposes of this provision, the distinguishing feature is function, not topic: the same episode can be described analytically or reduced to a template.

[Cross-domain, general] The following constitute recognised areas of legitimate inquiry within this field: any question whose answer is understanding rather than capability, the treaty, regulatory and screening regimes themselves, protective, clinical, detection and preparedness knowledge and history, policy analysis, journalism and teaching. The following fall within the classes of technical information subject to control: anything that moves someone materially closer to acquiring, producing or delivering a weapon, whatever framing is attached. For the purposes of this provision, the category is defined by what a response would be used to do, not by a list of forbidden words; almost every substance and organism involved has legitimate uses that vastly outnumber the illegitimate ones.
